title: REPORT on the control of the financial activities of the European Investment Bank Group – annual report 2024
part_text: 11. Expresses strong concern over the EIB’s continued and enhanced targeted investments in defence; stresses that the EIB should invest in a safe and secure Europe by promoting economic and environmental sustainability, supporting low and middle-income households in the energy transition, contributing to the renovation and construction of quality public and social housing, strengthening public services and enhancing disaster preparedness;
